# GEOX — Earth Intelligence Sovereign Kernel (19 Public Tools)
> Doctrine: Physics before narrative. Governed evidence only.
> Surface: generated from registry.py::CANONICAL_PUBLIC_TOOLS

## 1. Canonical Tool Surface

1. **geox_basin**: Unified basin intelligence: profile, resolve, macrostrat, backstrip, mass balance, thermal maturity, map context, deep time, tectonic reconstruction.
2. **geox_claim**: Claim lifecycle: create, validate, challenge, seal, evidence, falsify, synthesize, contradict. Modes: create, validate, challenge, seal, attach, falsify, discover, synthesize, abduct, contradict, scan.
3. **geox_contrast_metabolize**: Unified anomalous contrast metabolic pipeline. Binds three stages into one call: ISOLATE (deterministic acoustic impedance contrast detection) then MEASURE (AVO gradient + LMR estimates) then CLASSIFY (>=3 stratigraphic trap hypotheses). substrate_class=INERT. Local max QUALIFIED_CANDIDATE - arifOS seals.
4. **geox_deep_time**: Deep time: Earth state, dynamical systems, DDE reasoning. Modes: dde_reason.
5. **geox_geomechanics**: Geomechanical analysis: bulk/shear/young modulus, poisson ratio, acoustic impedance, stress polygon.
6. **geox_map**: Map intelligence: layer discovery, scene composition, preview. Modes: layers_list, scene_plan, render_preview.
7. **geox_model**: Geological modeling: subsurface inversion, 2D cross-sections, GemPy 3D. Modes: subsurface, geological_generate, gempy_3d.
8. **geox_petrophysics**: Unified petrophysics: Vsh, porosity, Sw, permeability, net pay, LEM inference, QC. Modes: generate, verify, lem_inference, stoip_feed, qc.
9. **geox_prospect**: Prospect evaluation: volumetrics, POS, EVOI, risk assessment. Modes: screen, evaluate.
10. **geox_seismic_compute**: Seismic computation: forward model, well tie, attributes, wavelet extraction, inversion.
11. **geox_seismic_ingest**: SEG-Y I/O, header inspection, export.
12. **geox_seismic_interpret**: One semantic capability — propose geometry, physics-gate, compare hypotheses (NOT autonomous SEAL). Live modes: horizon_contrast, fault_sticks, volume_frame, blend, structure_validate, interpret (interpretation_bundle ≥3 hyps), interpret_section/rsi_pipeline (INT_SEISMIC), segy_slice. Gates return PASS|WARN|KILL|UNMEASURED + receipt_hash. preferred_hypothesis always null from GEOX. Local max QUALIFIED_CANDIDATE — arifOS seals only.
13. **geox_source**: Source rock & diagenesis: TOC, kerogen, maturity, compaction. Modes: source_rock, diagenesis.
14. **geox_spatial**: Spatial intelligence: H3, LanceDB, STAC. Modes: h3_index, lancedb_store, stac_discover.
15. **geox_temporal**: Temporal analytics: decline curve, RRR, basin lifecycle, cadence. Modes: decline, rrr, basin_lifecycle, cadence.
16. **geox_well**: Well intelligence: view curves, open desk, desurvey. Modes: view, desk.
17. **geox_well_ingest**: Load well log data from LAS, SEG-Y, DST, deviation, or tops files. Auto-detects format.
18. **geox_well_qc**: Quality control for well data: depth monotonicity, null %, physical range checks.
19. **geox_workspace**: GEOX Workspace — persistent geological context across all tools. Set basin/play/well once; every tool inherits. Modes: set, view, history, evidence, relations, reset.

## 2. Agent Reasoning Logic
- Evidence before interpretation.
- Governance stays server-side.
- App-enabled workspace URI: `ui://geox/workspace-v1.html` (text/html;profile=mcp-app).
